title: Your time-in streak
description: The home page and the dashboard now show how many working days in a row you have timed in, right beside the Time in / out button.
items: Not timing in yet today does not break it — the count waits for today's time-in
Weekends and holidays do not count and do not break it; a day you time in on a weekend still counts
A working day with no time-in starts it again from zero — including a day on leave
